reading_note: The arc: Divine truth (First Man) descends clothed in the five discrete degrees of good (the elements) to engage self-love at its root. Self-love arms its ruling falsities with the fire of cupidity and the wind of false thought, and dresses them in the "garment of lions" — the fierce predatory affections. These archons devour those affections, and from their mouths pours a river — divine truth turned to judgment, which burns them continuously. The whole cosmos of natural lust is destined to be dissolved; its wrathful voice will be silenced. The visible judgment on earth is but one thread of a thousand hidden processes by which divine truth, wearing the elements as armor, undoes the dominion of self-love and frees the captive light. The teaching ends turning to the silver garments — the wisdom-clothing in which divine truth wages this war.
